name: add_domain
description: Connect a new sending domain to the workspace and verify DNS. Registers a new sending domain under the workspace, saves it, and immediately initiates DNS and deliverability verification (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, blacklists). USE THIS when setting up a new custom domain to send cold emails from Ballast. DO NOT use to test an external or unverified domain without adding it to the workspace (use check_domain instead) or to list existing domains (use list_domains instead).

name: add_leads_to_campaign
description: Add leads from lists (or by id) to a campaign Skips leads already in the campaign, unsubscribed, bounced or suppressed leads, and addresses verification found invalid.

name: add_mailbox
description: Connect a mailbox Tests SMTP and IMAP login first and saves only when both pass. Google needs an app password. Microsoft 365 connects with OAuth from the dashboard.

name: add_suppressions
description: Suppress addresses or whole domains Up to 10,000 values per call: emails, or domains written as @acme.com. Matching leads are marked suppressed.

name: check_domain
description: Inspect DNS and deliverability health of any domain without adding it. Performs a live, read-only diagnostic check on any domain name (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC records, blacklist status, and domain age) with actionable DNS fix instructions. Results are cached for 10 minutes. USE THIS to test or grade arbitrary prospect or candidate domains without saving or connecting them. DO NOT use to configure a domain for sending in Ballast (use add_domain instead) or to view already configured sending domains (use list_domains instead).

domain.description: Domain to grade, e.g. yourdomain.com. URLs and email addresses are accepted.

selector.description: Optional custom DKIM selector to check in addition to the common ones.

name: create_campaign
description: Create a draft campaign Starts with one empty email. Use set_sequence to write the emails, then add leads and mailboxes.

name: get_billing
description: Plan, subscription status, emails and AI drafts used this period

name: get_campaign
description: Get a campaign with its sequence, schedule and settings

name: get_campaign_analytics
description: Multi-dimensional performance breakdown by provider, mailbox, and sentiment. Returns granular aggregate performance metrics broken down across email providers (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, etc.), individual sending mailboxes, and reply sentiment classifications. USE THIS to diagnose deliverability issues across providers or compare mailbox performance. DO NOT use for day-by-day time-series data (use get_campaign_stats instead) or macro workspace KPI totals (use get_overview instead).

name: get_campaign_stats
description: Daily time-series email metrics for a campaign or all campaigns. Returns daily time-series counts (day-by-day sent, replied, opened, bounced, positive) for a specific campaign (pass campaignId) or all campaigns combined over the last N days. USE THIS to plot charts or view daily performance trends over time. DO NOT use for high-level workspace summary totals (use get_overview instead) or for multi-dimensional breakdowns by ESP provider, mailbox, or step (use get_campaign_analytics instead).

name: get_launch_checklist
description: What has to be fixed before launch Required items block the launch; warnings are advice.

name: get_overview
description: Workspace-wide aggregate email outreach totals and trends. Returns macro-level aggregate counts (total sends, replies, positive replies, bounces, won deals) across the entire workspace for the last 7, 30, or 90 days, comparing against the prior period for trend analysis. USE THIS for high-level workspace executive summaries. DO NOT use for a single campaign (use get_campaign_stats instead) or for provider/mailbox breakdowns (use get_campaign_analytics instead).

name: get_thread
description: A thread with every message, the campaign emails and the lead

name: get_unibox_filters
description: Unibox counts by label, mailbox and campaign

name: import_leads
description: Import leads in chunks Send up to 5,000 rows per call. The first call creates the import and returns its id; pass importId with every next chunk and final: true with the last. Addresses are deduped, suppressed ones skipped, invalid ones counted. ESP detection and verification run in the background after the final chunk.

importId.description: Leave out on the first call; pass the id it returns with every next chunk.

list.description: List to add every imported lead to: an existing id or a new name

existing.description: Leads already in the workspace: leave them as they are, or fill in the new values

verify.description: Verify the new addresses with the verifier API after import

final.description: Last chunk: starts ESP detection and verification

name: label_thread
description: Set or clear a thread's label The lead gets the label for the thread's campaign and the label's triggers run (suppress, stop in campaign, pause campaign, move to list). null clears it.

name: launch_campaign
description: Launch or resume a campaign Runs the launch checklist first and refuses when a required item fails. The worker then sends inside the schedule window.

name: list_campaigns
description: List campaigns Newest first, with lead counts by progress.

name: list_domains
description: List all connected sending domains and their verification status. Returns all custom sending domains currently registered in the workspace, including their mailbox count, latest deliverability scores, and verification history. USE THIS to review existing sending infrastructure. DO NOT use to register a new domain (use add_domain instead) or to test an external domain without adding it (use check_domain instead).

name: list_lead_lists
description: Lead lists with counts

name: list_leads
description: List leads Paged, newest first by default. Filter by list, label, status, verification and ESP, or search email, name and company.

labelId.description: Only leads with this label; 'none' for leads without labels

name: list_mailboxes
description: List mailboxes Connected sending mailboxes with today's limit, ramp-up and the DNS health of their domain.

name: list_threads
description: Reply threads, newest first Filter by unread, label, mailbox or campaign. Page with `cursor` from the previous answer.

labelId.description: A label id, or "none" for threads without a label

search.description: Matches the lead's email, name or company, and the subject

name: pause_campaign
description: Pause a running campaign Nothing more is sent until it is launched again. Emails already handed to the provider still arrive.

name: preview_campaign
description: Render every step and variant for one lead Shows the emails exactly as that lead would get them, with spintax resolved the way it will be for them. Defaults to the first lead in the campaign.

name: send_reply
description: Answer a thread Sends from the mailbox the conversation is on, in the same thread (In-Reply-To and References), to whoever wrote last. The previous message is quoted below.

name: set_sequence
description: Replace the whole sequence Steps in order, each with 1 to 5 variants. Bodies may be plain text (blank lines split paragraphs) or simple HTML. Use {{first_name}} style variables, {{first_name|there}} for a fallback, {Hi|Hello} spintax, and put {{unsubscribe}} in the first email. Only drafts and paused campaigns.

name: update_campaign
description: Rename a campaign or change its schedule, mailboxes and options

timezoneFallback.description: IANA timezone for leads without one

dailyCap.description: First emails a day for the campaign; null = only mailbox limits

bounceThreshold.description: Pause at this bounce rate (%); null = workspace default

startOn.description: Optional first sending day (YYYY-MM-DD, in timezoneFallback). Null = start when launched

endOn.description: Optional last sending day (YYYY-MM-DD, in timezoneFallback). After it nothing goes out and the campaign pauses. Null = no end

stopForCompany.description: When a lead replies, stop the sequence for everyone at the same company domain (free-mail domains excluded)

skipRisky.description: Leave out risky and catch-all leads: skipped when added and before their first email

name: whoami
description: Who am I: the user, workspace and plan behind this key or session

name: write_sequence
description: Write emails with AI from the offer profile. Drafts a whole sequence (mode sequence) or a new version of one variant (rewrite, shorter, angle), using only facts from the workspace offer profile and lead fields. Results are saved as new variants and never overwrite existing text; an empty campaign gets the drafted steps. Each email is checked against the content checklist; anything still failing comes back in problems. Requires that the workspace offer profile is configured in Ballast settings (or updated via update_offer_profile).

mode.description: sequence = draft every step; rewrite, shorter, angle = a new version of one variant

variantId.description: rewrite, shorter, angle: the variant to start from (required)

angle.description: Optional angle or notes, e.g. 'lead with the cost of manual payroll'

persona.description: Optional target persona, e.g. 'operations managers at restaurant groups'
